result.instructions: Tools for HR WORKS, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who is absent from work this week, and what kind of absence is it?"; "Which job postings are open right now, and when does each offer expire?"; "List the active persons in one organization unit.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes HR WORKS data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run hrworks_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run hrworks_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run hrworks_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. hrworks_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: hrworks_list_persons
tools.title: List persons
tools.description: List the persons in the company, or in the given organization units, grouped by organization unit. Use it to find a person identifier. HR WORKS API: GET /v2/persons.

organizationUnits.description: Organization unit identifiers (numbers by default, see identifierType). Only persons in these units are returned.

identifierType.description: Type of the organizationUnits identifiers: number (default) or uuid.

onlyActive.description: Only active records (default true). Set false to include records of people who have left the company.

onlyActiveOrganizationUnits.description: Only persons in active organization units (default true). Set false to include persons without an active unit.

tools.name: hrworks_get_person
tools.title: Get person
tools.description: Get the base data of one person (names, personnel number, uuid, external ids). HR WORKS API: GET /v2/persons/{personIdentifier}.

personIdentifier.description: The person identifier. personIdentifierType says which kind of value this is.

tools.name: hrworks_list_organization_units
tools.title: List organization units
tools.description: List the active organization units (departments, locations) with their number, uuid and name. HR WORKS API: GET /v2/organization-units.

tools.name: hrworks_list_absences
tools.title: List absences
tools.description: List the absences (vacation, sickness and other absence types) of persons in a date interval. The interval may be one year at most. Paged: use nextPage. HR WORKS API: GET /v2/absences.

persons.description: Person identifiers: HR WORKS usernames by default, personnel numbers when usePersonnelNumbers is true.

usePersonnelNumbers.description: Set true when the persons list holds personnel numbers instead of HR WORKS usernames.

types.description: Only absences of these absence type keys. Keys come from the absence types of the company.

statusFilter.description: Only return records with one of these status values.

onlyActive.description: Only active records (default true). Set false to include records of people who have left the company.

page.description: Result page, starting at 1 (default 1). Pass the nextPage value of the previous answer to get more.

tools.name: hrworks_list_posts
tools.title: List job postings
tools.description: List the job postings (posts) of the company. Active posts are the open job postings; each post lists its offers with publicationDate and validUntilDate. Paged: use nextPage. HR WORKS API: GET /v3/applicant-management/posts.

onlyActive.description: Only active records (default true). Set false to include records of people who have left the company.

page.description: Result page, starting at 1 (default 1). Pass the nextPage value of the previous answer to get more.

tools.name: hrworks_list_job_applications
tools.title: List job applications
tools.description: List the job applications, optionally for given posts and status values. Each page holds 50 applications. Paged: use nextPage. HR WORKS API: GET /v2/applicant-management/job-applications.

posts.description: Post identifiers to return applications for (from hrworks_list_posts).

statusFilter.description: Only return records with one of these status values.

page.description: Result page, starting at 1 (default 1). Pass the nextPage value of the previous answer to get more.
